publication.analysis-and-design-of-a-pla: Analysis and Design of a Platform for Real-Time Speech Translation
Interactive analysis of event-driven architecture, VAD–ASR–MT–TTS and measured latency in a master's thesis on speech translation.
This interactive thesis presents the problem, design, pipeline and selected evaluation results from the multilanguage revision of the original work.
Hvordan bygger man en sporbar, modulær p: How do you build a traceable, modular speech translation pipeline — and what latency does coordinating AI models across services introduce?
Redaktionel, interaktiv formidling — ikk: An interactive editorial explanation, not a verbatim reproduction. Academic source: the private repository
. Original PDF afventer særskilt publice: . The original PDF is awaiting separate publication approval.

højere hale-latenstid i den skalerede op: higher tail latency in the scaled deployment
Oversættelse er ikke kun et modelproblem: Translation is more than a model problem.
En tale-til-tale-oversættelse består af: Speech-to-speech translation involves several dependent stages. The system must first detect speech in an audio stream, then recognize words, translate them and synthesize new speech. Each stage can fail, and delays accumulate throughout the pipeline.
Afhandlingen undersøger derfor ikke blot: The thesis therefore examines not only the quality of AI models but also
hvordan man orkestrerer, sporer og måler: how to orchestrate, trace and measure a distributed pipeline
. Centralt står et eventdrevet mikroserv: . The work centers on an event-driven microservices design and a controlled evaluation in a local k3s environment.
Forskningsfokus: sekventiel VAD → ASR →: Research focus: sequential VAD → ASR → MT → TTS, state control, traceability through correlation IDs and latency measurements under load.
Follow a speech segment through the system.
Vælg et trin for at se, hvad det gør. Af: Select a stage to explore its function. The playback illustrates the sequence described in the thesis; it is an explanatory animation and does not process real audio.
Identificerer et talesegment, som kan se: Detects a speech segment that can be forwarded. Segmenting audio is the first step of the controlled pipeline.
En forenklet fremstilling. I implementer: A simplified illustration. In the implementation, the Orchestrator controls phase transitions through events and validates the workflow state before activating the next service.
frem for, at hver AI-service selv bestem: rather than having each AI service choose the next step. The Orchestrator manages state transitions, Kafka carries commands and results, and large audio artifacts are stored separately in MinIO.
Modtager lyd, håndterer ind- og udgang o: Receives audio, manages input and output, and publishes artifact references rather than sending large audio files through the event log.
Events bærer metadata og URI'er, mens Mi: Events carry metadata and URIs, while MinIO stores audio and other large artifacts. This separates control traffic from data storage.
Ugyldige ruter eller manglende afhængigh: Invalid routes or missing dependencies should halt progression rather than produce incorrect output. The thesis tests selected failure cases, not general fault tolerance.
Diagrammet er en forenklet konceptuel ov: This simplified conceptual overview is based on the PlantUML sources in the design chapter; it is not a complete network topology.
Skalering gjorde ikke systemet entydigt: Scaling did not consistently improve performance.
I de primære belastningstests med samtid: In the main load tests at concurrency
gennemførte både single-lane og den skal: both the single-lane and scaled deployments completed without observed errors. Some medians improved, but all compared P90 values were higher in the scaled configuration.
TTFT P50: Den skalerede opsætning er hur: TTFT P50: The scaled configuration is faster at c=1–4 but slower at c=5.

TTFT: time to first text. TTFA: time to: TTFT: time to first text. TTFA: time to first audio. P50: median. P90: 90th percentile. All figures are transcribed from the evaluation comparison tables; this is not a live benchmark.
Alle 25 prøver i det faste testmateriale: All 25 samples in the fixed test set produced both translation and TTS artifacts. This finding is limited to the evaluated dataset.
Gennemsnitlig residualtid på tværs af 14: Mean residual time across 140 selected correlations: approximately 13.9% of mean internal pipeline latency.
Alle matchede P90-tal var dårligere ved: All matched P90 values were worse for the scaled implementation. Placement and resource contention limit what this experiment can establish.
Sporbarhed og kontrol er styrker. Realti: Traceability and control are strengths. Real-time performance remains a challenge.
Afhandlingen viser, at eventdrevne mikro: The thesis shows that event-driven microservices with central orchestration can provide a useful foundation for a modular, traceable speech translation pipeline. The architecture supports explicit contracts, controlled phase transitions and reproducible evaluation.
Men distribuerede grænser har en pris. D: Distributed boundaries have a cost. The estimated 13.9% average non-model time is an
, ikke et præcist mål for hver enkelt se: , not a precise overhead measure for each individual session. The negative median residual in the report highlights uncertainty when subtracting different timestamps.
Evalueringen måler fra det øjeblik, Orch: The evaluation measures from the time the Orchestrator receives the pipeline event until the final TTS artifact is available. It does
den fulde oplevede klient-til-klient-lat: measure full perceived client-to-client latency and does not establish a production-ready real-time system.
